title: Retiform
summary: RET'IFORM, adjective [Latin retiformis; rete, a net, and forma, form.] Having the form of a net in texture; composed of crossing lines and interstices; as the retiform coat of the eye.

inlines.v: RET'IFORM, adjective [Latin retiformis; rete, a net, and forma, form.] Having the form of a net in texture; composed of crossing lines and interstices; as the retiform coat of the eye.
